from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(1-mu)/2; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+2*norm.pdf(a)/sf-3.5 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,-10,3.4)
assert abs(mu-2.879)<0.06
